method: Independent direct HTTP status, redirect, media-type and content-hash checks plus Stonepeak strategy, portfolio, transaction and regulatory inspection; operating-company test, real-estate classification, platform continuity and exit search

verifiedClaims: Stonepeak places supply-chain assets within its Real Estate strategy
Stonepeak describes the assets as real estate with infrastructure-like characteristics rather than operating infrastructure
The strategy centers on durable cash flows and property ownership and highlights warehouse portfolios near ports and intermodal terminals
Stonepeak uses Infrastructure Logistics Platform as a portfolio display label with a June 2021 investment date
No separate operating-company website, legal name or service business is disclosed
The portfolio page distinguishes actual operating transport businesses from property programs
Stonepeak's infrastructure transport-and-logistics strategy emphasizes operating businesses and essential services
The warehouse-property program is not presented as an operating company on this strategy page
SREP Port Logistics (Co-Invest) Holdings LP is a private investment vehicle
Stonepeak Real Estate Associates LP is its general partner and Stonepeak Real Estate Advisors LLC its adviser
The filing does not establish a separate operating logistics company or the vehicle's full asset perimeter
Stonepeak sold the 1.3 million square foot Omni Industrial Campus on October 24, 2023
Stonepeak frames the asset as an industrial real-estate development and sale
Omni's realization does not prove a sale of one consolidated logistics operating platform
Stonepeak acquired six Houston logistics properties totaling 2.3 million square feet in December 2024
Stonepeak says its Real Estate team acquired 20 logistics assets totaling seven million square feet in 2024
The release describes supply-chain real estate near port infrastructure, not cargo-handling or freight services
Stonepeak closed a two-building, approximately 748,000-square-foot Fort Worth property acquisition in 2025
The release identifies the Real Estate team and property leasing characteristics
Stonepeak's Real Estate team closed another Fort Worth warehouse acquisition on August 11, 2026
The 860,100-square-foot rail-served property confirms an active real-estate acquisition program through the cutoff
Rail adjacency does not establish a railroad, terminal or freight-service operating business

exitSearch.result: The warehouse real-estate acquisition program remained active through the August 11, 2026 Fort Worth closing. No sale, recapitalization, rename or pending transfer of a consolidated operating platform was found. The 2023 Omni sale is an asset-level property realization, not evidence of an operating-company exit.
